title: sphenopholis nitida var. glabra
intro: Sphenopholis nitida var. glabra, commonly known as Smooth Sphenopholis, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sphenopholis nitida var. glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
